by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T M x₀ hM hb hx₀ he
  apply le_antisymm (T.opNorm_le_bound hM hb)
  have h := T.le_opNorm x₀

  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx₀)
